products.name: Lilac Reverie
products.desc: Four clouded-glass blossoms in pale lilac, gathered around dark crystal centres with small zircon accents. The colour stays soft against dark hair and skin, while the clustered shape creates a clear profile.

products.name: Serpentine Psalm
products.desc: A serpent silhouette in pale turquoise and oxblood enamel, balanced by red glass drops. The long curve frames the jaw and gives a plain shirt or dark tailored collar a sharper line.

products.name: Morpho Nocturne
products.desc: A layered blue-green resin wing held in gold-tone filigree, with dark centre stones and a faceted drop. The surface shifts between cobalt and green as the light moves.

products.name: Nocturne of the Deep
products.desc: Four small silver-tone pins shaped as a shell, a pearl-tone bead, a coral branch and a long filament. Wear the group on a lapel, or separate one piece as a quieter mark.

products.name: Coral Reliquary
products.desc: Coral-tone glass drops held in gold-tone filigree, with blue-green resin cabochons at the crown and zircon drops. The warm red-orange reads strongly against black and ecru.

products.name: Opaline Arch Cuff
products.desc: An open gold-tone cuff with four blue-green resin panels and a border of zircon. Its wide horizontal line gives the wrist presence without competing with rings.

products.name: Two Doves
products.desc: Two silver-tone doves face a faceted yellow-glass drop, with zircon detailing across the wings. The curved band frames the collarbone and works against both bare skin and a dark neckline.
